history_interval: closed at both ends: [origin - history_duration, origin]
origin_rule: Per-subject date_range from first through last aligned timestamp at protocol stride; phase anchored to subject start, never reset by a gap. Origins in inserted rows are retained as candidates and rejected by continuity.
continuity_rule: Treat every source interval longer than one minute as a continuity boundary and retain >15, >60, and >1440 minute audit flags.
continuity_implementation: Entire closed history-start to target interval must lie within the origin's inherited subject/source segment. No source-gap tolerance.
valid_history_value: Finite, nonmissing published source value; no inserted grid point and no project interpolation. Native device anchor status remains unknown.
target_rule: Exact subject + target timestamp, finite nonmissing published value; no filling, interpolation, nearest match, or label repair.
intermediate_horizon_values: Not required to be nonmissing; only structural source continuity is checked between origin and target. These future values are never predictors.
flow_accounting: Sequential, first-failure exclusions in the saved stage order; later failures are not counted again.
all_cohort_processing: Fixed structural construction only; labels persisted without outcome-distribution or performance analysis; split-boundary eligibility is applied at split assignment.

availability_policy.global_cutoff_rule: An input may be used only if both its event time and its availability time are at or before origin time t.
availability_policy.future_information_rule: No value, aggregate, metadata, or preprocessing result that depends on times after t may enter the input.

glucose_history.rule: Released glucose values require timestamps at or before t; target-horizon glucose is excluded from input.

activity.rule: Only activity minutes available by t may be used; future minutes, centered filters, completed-day summaries, and missing-as-zero substitutions are excluded.

meal_logs.rule: Meal type and nutrients cannot be backfilled before the log existed; the released meal timestamp does not establish upload time.

amount_consumed.rule: Final Amount Consumed cannot be used before meal completion and cannot retrospectively rescale nutrients without a separate justified rule.

meal_photos.rule: Photo content requires verified capture, upload, and feature-extraction availability by t; paths and folder identities are excluded as predictors.

static_measurements.rule: Bio, Gut, and Microbiome results may enter only when result availability before the prediction period is established; later-returned results cannot be backfilled.

calendar_context.rule: Shifted calendar dates cannot represent real season, holiday, or calendar context.

identifiers_and_metadata.rule: Subject identifiers, file paths, image paths, export indices, and source metadata are not ordinary predictive features.

offline_interpretation.scope: retrospective forecasting protocol on released, shifted, one-minute aligned data

availability_limit: History completeness certifies released source support, not verified live arrival by origin; unresolved arrival and publisher interpolation remain offline limitations.
